description: Charges the exact approved USD booking total using a Stripe shared payment token from the customer's authorized wallet, then verifies reservation confirmation. First call get_booking_status and obtain explicit customer approval of that total and the booking terms. Never accept card numbers, CVC, or saved-card IDs. The token must be issued to the returned Stripe business profile for this amount. Retries reuse the SAME checkout_url; this tool never creates another reservation. Follow customer_action: verify_in_agent_wallet means the issuing wallet must handle the issued token's next_action before retrying this same booking. Only a confirmed result means the ride is booked.

approved_total_cents.description: Exact USD total from get_booking_status that the customer explicitly approved for payment.

checkout_url.description: Exact secure checkout_url from book_ride. Treat it as private; never search for or share it publicly.

customer_confirmed.description: Only true after the customer approves this booking, its final total, terms, and this one-time payment through their agent wallet.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token obtained from the customer's approved wallet, scoped to the returned Stripe profile and total. Never card numbers, CVCs, saved-card IDs, or a token invented by the assistant.

name: complete_booking
title: Pay and confirm an approved reservation
